honesty_note: INCONCLUSIVE is treated as 'no evidence', never as proven.

C1_convex_combination_neq_input.interpretation: correct: a convex combination lies between its inputs, so composition never exceeds the best component — it can only combine strengths.

C3_containment_zero_on_disjoint.interpretation: by definition of set intersection; no re-weighting changes it.

C4_min_identity.interpretation: abs/min not parseable by suuri-chan; it correctly fails closed with INCONCLUSIVE rather than a false 'proven'.
